properties.name: picsure.gateway.health.status-window-ms
properties.description: Throttle window, in milliseconds, during which GET /system/status reuses the last computed deep-health result instead of re-running SystemHealthService's check.

properties.name: picsure.gateway.rate-limit.enabled
properties.description: Master switch for both rate-limit stages (pre-validation per-IP throttle and post-grant per-key limiter). Enabling requires trusted-proxies. Env: RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED.

properties.name: picsure.gateway.rate-limit.user.burst-per-minute
properties.description: Requests per USER key per minute, reset on the minute boundary. Must be positive. Env: RATE_LIMIT_USER_BURST_PER_MINUTE.

properties.name: picsure.gateway.rate-limit.user.sustained-per-day
properties.description: Requests per USER key per day, reset at midnight UTC. Must be positive. Env: RATE_LIMIT_USER_SUSTAINED_PER_DAY.

properties.name: picsure.gateway.rate-limit.session.burst-per-minute
properties.description: Requests per open-access session per minute, reset on the minute boundary. Must be positive. Env: RATE_LIMIT_SESSION_BURST_PER_MINUTE.

properties.name: picsure.gateway.rate-limit.session.sustained-per-day
properties.description: Requests per open-access session per day, reset at midnight UTC. Must be positive. Env: RATE_LIMIT_SESSION_SUSTAINED_PER_DAY.

properties.name: picsure.gateway.rate-limit.ip.burst-per-minute
properties.description: Post-grant requests per client IP (IPv6 /64) per minute, for valid requests with no key or a PLATFORM key from a non-allowlisted source. Must be positive. Env: RATE_LIMIT_IP_BURST_PER_MINUTE.

properties.name: picsure.gateway.rate-limit.ip.sustained-per-day
properties.description: Post-grant requests per client IP (IPv6 /64) per day, reset at midnight UTC. Must be positive. Env: RATE_LIMIT_IP_SUSTAINED_PER_DAY.

properties.name: picsure.gateway.rate-limit.ip.prevalidation-per-minute
properties.description: Requests per client IP (IPv6 /64) per minute that may reach PSAMA key validation. Must be positive. Env: RATE_LIMIT_IP_PREVALIDATION_PER_MINUTE.

properties.name: picsure.gateway.rate-limit.store.max-subjects
properties.description: Maximum number of rate-limit buckets held in memory; past it the least-valuable bucket is evicted, never a request rejected. Must be positive. Env: RATE_LIMIT_STORE_MAX_SUBJECTS.

properties.name: picsure.gateway.rate-limit.trusted-proxies
properties.description: Comma-separated CIDRs of the proxies in front of the gateway whose X-Forwarded-For is honoured; a bare address is /32 or /128. Must include the reverse proxy (httpd) when rate limiting is enabled. Env: RATE_LIMIT_TRUSTED_PROXIES.

properties.name: picsure.gateway.rate-limit.platform-allowlisted-source-cidrs
properties.description: Comma-separated CIDRs of trusted platform sources. Every open-access request from them skips the pre-validation per-IP throttle, and PLATFORM-key requests from them are also exempt from the per-key limiter. Empty means no exemption. Env: RATE_LIMIT_PLATFORM_ALLOWLISTED_SOURCE_CIDRS.
